candidates.title: COPENHAGEN PLANK GUIDE | Form, Benefits, and Mistakes to Avoid
candidates.description:
JOIN TF2 STRENGTH: https://tf2strength.programs.app/

The Copenhagen plank is one of my favorite exercises for building the adductors and core.

I like the Copenhagen plank because it trains the adductors in a lengthened position and it's easy to modify. So, it can be a great adductor and core exercise for lifters at all skill levels.

In my Copenhagen plank guide, I'll cover how to properly perform this exercise, some benefits of it, and mistakes to avoid.

0:00 HOW TO Copenhagen Plank
2:41 Copenhagen Plank BENEFITS
4:37 Copenhagen Plank MISTAKES
5:59 Copenhagen Plank PROGRESSIONS
7:05 Final Thoughts

If you're not performing Copenhagen planks currently in your workout program, then it may be time to explore them for a block or two.

In my opinion, we could all use a little more direct adductor work and this exercise is great for strengthening them in a lengthened bias.

On top of this, the Copenhagen plank can be a great exercise to perform while traveling when you have no equipment and it's easy to modify.

If you have additional questions about the Copenhagen plank, drop a comment below or reach out via Instagram.
